publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of the Actuary
title_or_table: National Health Expenditures by source of funds, folded by the studio into four groups
universe_or_base: All national health expenditures, by who paid, in four groups
unit: millions of dollars, nominal; empty where a program did not yet exist (Medicare and Medicaid before 1966)
qualification: All other is the total minus private health insurance, Medicare and Medicaid: out of pocket; CHIP; the Departments of Defense and Veterans Affairs; other third party payers and programs; public health activity; and investment. Out of pocket is the largest part of all other, so a note names it
derivation: Keeps private health insurance, Medicare and Medicaid as published and sums every other payer line into all other, as total minus the three
printed_source_line: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, National Health Expenditure Accounts, spending by source of funds, 1960 to 2024, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Nominal dollars; all other payers, out of pocket the largest, folded into one group by Oath & Action.
